prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Sunlight After Sunset; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: One ordinary garden path with a self-contained black solar path light, small square top panel, enclosed battery and white LED beneath. Day-to-night sequence. Page 8 shows only one adult hand with medium brown skin and a plain gray sleeve lifting the fallen leaf; no recurring adult character.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One black solar path light; Square dark-blue top panel; Enclosed rechargeable battery; White LED; Nearby shrub casting a shadow
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 5. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): As evening grows dark, a control switches the lamp on. The battery now supplies energy to the light.
Required illustration: At dusk, same lamp begins glowing while the panel lies in dim light. Exact continuity: Automatic control is internal; no child switching exposed wires.
Exact current state: Automatic control is internal; no child switching exposed wires.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
CRITICAL SCENE VISIBILITY: Only ONE intact closed garden lamp at dusk; it turns on without a hand or operator. Panel remains dark blue. Lamp glows onto path. No exposed battery or wires, no people or hands.
Crisp flat vector-like outlines and clean color throughout ALL background, soil and path. No paper grain or brush texture.

visualReview.note: Lamp glows at dusk without any hand or operator; panel stays dark and hardware closed.
